findings.title: Clone block reason ignores late user load
findings.problem: getBlockReason reads userStore.user non-reactively (hasCreatableProject(userStore.user)). On a direct load of the clone URL, if the user finishes loading after the source details, the page evaluated 'no-project' and does not re-render when the user arrives.
findings.impact: Users can see a persistent 'You need access to at least one project' block and a disabled Save on a valid clone. Reachability unconfirmed: depends on loadUser timing vs getIndexDetails.
findings.recommendation: Use useSnapshot(userStore) and pass user into getBlockReason so it re-evaluates; treat an unloaded user as loading rather than no-project.

findings.title: Clone page Save/Cancel wiring untested
findings.problem: DataSourceClonePage.test mocks DataSourceForm and PageLayout so rightContent, ref, onReadyChange, onSubmittingChange and navigateBack are never exercised; the integration test calls ref.submit() directly, bypassing the page.
findings.impact: Dropping the ref, the ready/submitting props or Save onClick would ship a Save button that never submits or stays disabled while all tests pass.
findings.recommendation: Add a page test with a forwardRef form stub (submit spy, calls onReadyChange(true)) and a PageLayout mock rendering rightContent; assert Save gating, one submit call on click, and Cancel calling navigateBack(DATASOURCE_DETAILS, DATASOURCES).

findings.title: Clone menu icon collides with Copy ID
findings.problem: The spec requires an icon import name that does not collide with CopySvg (used for Copy ID), but the Clone item uses <CopySvg /> (line 169), the same icon as Copy ID (line 199).
findings.impact: Required spec item only partially met; the two menu items are visually indistinguishable.
findings.recommendation: Use a distinct icon for Clone under a non-colliding import name.
